pages.title: Lepton Triplet
pages.text: Electron, muon and tau, three charged leptons differing only in mass, each paired with its own neutrino. None of them feel the strong force. The triplet hangs together loosely, and the neutrinos seem to drift straight through my hand without noticing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Neutrino flux passes through almost everything, so I used a sterile neutrino as a bait and antimatter to tag charged partners. The Particle Spectrometer separated three charged leptons, each shadowed by its neutrino flavour.
